title: Add ⚛️ Cosmos Ecosystem ⚛️  as Publisher
summary: If this proposal passes, ⚛️ Cosmos Ecosystem ⚛️  will be added as publisher on CoinTrunk module. ⚛️ Cosmos Ecosystem ⚛️  is a major contributor in Cosmos providing latest news regarding blockchains in this ecosystem. You can check them on twitter(x) https://x.com/CosmosEcosystem. Make sure you follow them for latest news, BZE news are always included.
